o.norm: should resovle to an absolute url:

i.norm:
{@link StringUtil#resolve(String, String)} must strip ASCII control characters (0x00-0x1F) from both the base and relative URLs before resolving, mirroring how browsers normalise URLs.

Here both inputs are peppered with control characters:

  • base {@code "\nhttps://\texample.com/"} cleans to {@code "https://example.com/"}
  • relative {@code "\r\nfo\to:ba\br"} cleans to {@code "foo:bar"}
Once the control characters are removed, {@code "foo:bar"} is already an absolute URL (it has a scheme), so it resolves to itself.
